wiki_acceptance: Click-drag places a ROW/RECT of wall (or floor) blueprints, not a single cell.
summary: Added ONE NEW self-bootstrapping file BlueprintDragDesignation.cs implementing drag-rect/line blueprint placement (#18) by calling ONLY BuildManager's read-only public API (BuildModeActive / CurrentMode / SizeFor / TryPlaceAt). ZERO edits to BuildManager.cs, ArchitectMenu.cs, the other designation managers, AudioBank.cs, any test/asmdef, or any SceneSetup file. ZERO SceneSetup budget (ghost preview is a runtime-built 4-quad outline, self-attached to the hidden manager GO).

behavior.activation: Operates ONLY while BuildManager.Instance != null && BuildModeActive. Build mode and the designation modes are already mutually exclusive (designation managers turn build mode off), so this never fights deconstruct/mine/grow.
behavior.press_down: On left mouse-DOWN inside the map (not over UI) records the anchor world point (pressStartWorld); does NOT itself place — BuildManager's existing Update places the single anchor cell on the same DOWN.
behavior.drag: Once the cursor moves past dragThreshold (0.6 world units) it becomes a DRAG; a live ghost rect (4 thin code-built outline quads) follows the cursor every frame.
behavior.release_commit: On left mouse-UP, if it was a drag, loops EVERY covered cell (stepping by the buildable footprint via BuildManager.SizeFor so 1x2 beds tile without overlap) calling BuildManager.TryPlaceAt(cx,cy) once per cell. 1-wide drag = degenerate line/row. maxCellsPerDrag=400 safety cap.
behavior.tap_vs_drag: A plain tap (< dragThreshold) is left entirely to BuildManager's single-cell path — this manager does nothing, so single-cell placement is unchanged.
behavior.no_double_place: The anchor cell may already hold the blueprint BuildManager dropped on mouse-DOWN; a repeat TryPlaceAt there is harmlessly rejected by BuildManager's own CellOccupied validation (detects BlueprintEntity). No cell is double-placed.
behavior.cancel: Right-click OR ESC mid-drag cancels with NO blueprints placed and hides the ghost. Build mode turning off mid-drag also aborts the drag.

bug_pattern_firewall.4_audio_buzz: AudioBank.Instance?.PlaySelect() called EXACTLY ONCE per committed drag (FinishCommit), never inside the per-cell TryPlaceAt loop — a 400-cell rect plays one blip.
bug_pattern_firewall.7_singleton_subscription_race: No OnEnable singleton subscription. BuildManager + AudioBank found via static Instance read-only EACH frame in Update.
bug_pattern_firewall.9_runinbackground_freeze: No WaitForSeconds / coroutine / always-on heartbeat. All timing is Time.unscaledTime-free polling inside Update; the only background object is the hidden DontDestroyOnLoad manager which does no timed work.
bug_pattern_firewall.self_bootstrap: [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(AfterSceneLoad)] + FindFirstObjectByType idempotency guard + Awake Instance guard — mirrors GrowZone/Mine/Deconstruct exactly. No double manager on domain/scene reload.

scene_wiring_flags_for_qa: FLAG: drag-ghost preview is a runtime-built 4-edge outline of unit white quads (1x1 white Texture2D, FilterMode.Point) parented to the hidden ~BlueprintDragDesignation GO, sortingOrder 25 (above the build ghost 20). NO prefab, NO imported PNG, never SceneSetup-wired. QA confirm: in build mode, press-drag shows a rectangle outline following the cursor.
FLAG: no toggle button added (build mode is already entered via BuildManager hotkeys B/F/G/T/Y/L + the Architect menu). This manager is purely an additive input layer; it needs no UI of its own.

QA verify binary #18: (1) enter build mode (B), press-drag over open ground -> a ROW/RECT of wall blueprints appears (NOT one cell); (2) drag a 1-wide span -> a line of blueprints; (3) right-click/ESC mid-drag -> no blueprints placed; (4) a plain tap still places exactly one cell.

QA test entry points (no real pointer needed): SimulateDragRect(Vector2 worldA, Vector2 worldB) and SimulateDragCells(Vector2Int a, Vector2Int b) both return the count placed; both require BuildModeActive.
